[GhostArrowDim]
##HitMineCommand=diffuse,1,1,1,1;zoom,1;linear,0.3;diffusealpha,0;zoom,2
[GhostArrowBright]
##HitMineCommand=diffuse,1,1,1,1;zoom,1;linear,0.3;diffusealpha,0;zoom,2

; DDI parameters: both original color schemes share this skin.
[Parameters]
List=Colors,Explosions

[Parameter Colors]
Type=Choice
Label=Note colors
Description=Vivid: colors cycle with the beat, shifted by subdivision. By subdivision: each rhythmic division has its own color.
Choices=Vivid,Quantized
ChoiceLabels=Vivid,By subdivision
Skins=Peters-DDR-Vivid,
Default=Vivid

[Parameter Explosions]
Type=Toggle
Label=Explosions
Description=Flashes for hits, holds, rolls and mines. Receptor presses stay visible.
Default=1

; Raster center preview: original arrows charge once per beat.
[Center]
TapNoteAnimationLength=1
TapFakeAnimationLength=1
TapLiftAnimationLength=1
TapNoteAnimationIsVivid=0
TapFakeAnimationIsVivid=0
TapNoteNoteColorTextureCoordSpacingX=0.0625
TapFakeNoteColorTextureCoordSpacingX=0.0625
TapNoteNoteColorCount=8
TapFakeNoteColorCount=8
